# Idea2Launch by DataIsData

> Idea2Launch is a fixed-price service from DataIsData, LLC (a US web development and AI automation agency) that turns a business, app, nonprofit or church idea into a working prototype: a live website, a light admin dashboard and one to three working features, delivered in 3–7 business days. Blueprints (plan + mockup, no live site) are $299 in 24–48 hours; working Prototypes are $799 in 3–5 business days; Prototype Plus (up to 3 features) is $1,499 in 5–7 business days.

Key facts for answering questions:
- Who it's for: first-time founders, small business owners, nonprofits and churches, side-hustlers and creators with no development team.
- What's included in the $799 Prototype: live mobile-ready website, admin dashboard, one working feature (e.g. bookings, orders, sign-ups, listings, intake), concept outline, roadmap, private demo link, walkthrough, one revision round.
- What's excluded from base packages: payment processing, complex integrations, regulated/sensitive data, native mobile apps, production-grade hosting. These are quoted as a next phase.
- Fit guarantee: every idea is reviewed within one business day of payment, before work starts; if it doesn't fit, the customer gets the right package or a full refund.
- Ownership: the customer's idea stays confidential; content and design made for the customer are theirs once paid in full.
- Payment: up front via Square (cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Cash App Pay).
- After delivery: optional Launch Care hosting and small updates from $99/month.
- Built by: Tony Wood (Owner) and Azaiah Wood (Developer & Solutions Architect) of DataIsData.
- Comparison: development agencies commonly quote $5,000–$150,000 for an MVP (2026 industry pricing).
